newsitem.title: UK: UK CBI warns against near-term rate rise.
newsitem.headline: UK CBI warns against near-term rate rise.

text.p: The Confederation of British Industry on Thursday warned against higher interest rates in the short-term but it conceded that the Bank of England faces a tough decision.
"Any rate rise in the short-term would be unwelcome but the Monetary Policy Committee has a very difficult balancing act," said Andrew Buxton, chairman of the CBI's economic affairs committee.
The Bank faces two key questions he said. To what extent is the strong pound going to subdue inflation and how much is consumer spending being driven by windfall gains.
The committee meets next on August 6 and 7.
